## Services I offer
1. Shopify Plus theme development and customization
2. Headless storefronts on Shopify Hydrogen, Next.js, Remix, or Builder.io
3. Shopify-to-headless migrations (and Shopify-from-legacy migrations)
4. Subscription, bundle, and gift-with-purchase experiences
5. Checkout Extensibility (Checkout UI Extensions, Checkout Blocks, post-purchase, Shopify Functions)
6. A/B testing programs, CRO audits, analytics implementation
7. Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse performance work
8. Design-to-code from Figma, PDP and cart redesigns
9. Technical discovery, scoping, and architecture for ecommerce teams
10. AI-assisted Shopify development (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, ChatGPT + Shopify AI Toolkit/Dev MCP), with senior human review on every change; AI workflow setup for in-house teams

## Core stack
Frontend: React, Next.js, Remix, Shopify Liquid, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS.
Backend / data: Node.js, Shopify Admin & Storefront GraphQL APIs, Shopify Functions (Rust / JS), Postgres, MongoDB.
Design: Figma, design systems, Polaris, UI/UX prototyping.
Commerce platforms: Shopify, Shopify Plus, Hydrogen, Builder.io, WooCommerce, BigCommerce.
Apps & integrations: Recharge, Klaviyo, Checkout Blocks, Bundle Builder, Shopify Functions, GA4, GTM.
AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, Google Antigravity/Gemini, ChatGPT/Codex, Shopify AI Toolkit, Shopify Dev MCP, Shopify CLI.

### How much does it cost to hire Logan Gelzer?
Engagements start at $100/hr with a $1,000 minimum project size as of November 2026. Most projects (PDP redesigns, checkout work, custom sections) run $2,000–$10,000. Retainers for ongoing development start at $2,000/month.

### Who is Logan Gelzer?
Logan Gelzer is a Senior Shopify Expert based in Homestead, FL, with 12+ years of ecommerce experience (since 2014) and 200+ brands served, specializing in Shopify Plus, Hydrogen, and conversion-optimized storefronts.

### What does Logan Gelzer specialize in?
Shopify Plus theme development, headless commerce with Hydrogen and Next.js, Checkout Extensibility and Shopify Functions, subscription and bundle flows with Recharge, A/B testing and CRO, and performance optimization.

### Does Logan Gelzer use AI tools like Claude Code or Cursor?
Yes. I use Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini and ChatGPT, connected to Shopify's AI Toolkit, to draft and validate code faster. I review and test every change myself, and nothing goes live without your approval. You get senior work delivered sooner, at the same rates.

### Is Logan Gelzer a freelancer or an agency?
I'm an independent Senior Shopify Expert: you get senior-level hands on every project, with trusted specialists added only when scope requires it. Not an agency, not a studio.
